verdict.rationale: SigNoz ships a free open-source edition that runs on your own infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes, Linux) and lets you 'keep full control of your data plane'. Self-hosting lets you choose where telemetry is stored, and community users cite this self-hosting option. Nothing in the pack documents choosing a region or data residency for SigNoz Cloud, so residency choice is only shown via self-hosting. missing for 10: documented SigNoz Cloud region/residency selection, explicit data-residency or compliance documentation

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Free open-source SigNoz that runs in your own infrastructure. Deploy with Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux and keep full control of your data plane.
They like SigNoz's self-hosting option and its OpenTelemetry basis.
